name: Vendtics – Email marketing solution for Newsletters, Campaigns, and Automation
author: TemplatePath

sections.description:
Create converting marketing automation to grow and nurture your audiences with 🚀 Vendtics email marketing plugin. Run faster campaigns with automated workflows and connect more effectively with your audiences.

✅ Get in touch: Official Website
✅ Get Started with Vendtics WordPress email marketing plugin: Your to guide
✅ Join Us online: Facebook Community

✉️ Vendtics – Your Go-to Email Marketing Solution for WordPress.

Vendtics is a powerful email marketing plugin that helps businesses run effective campaigns within the WordPress system.

Capture leads, organize and segment contacts, target effective leads, and build workflows that convert. With the Vendtics email marketing plugin for WordPress, you can tag and categorize contacts based on their behavior. You can even add 📋notes to segment them, get in-hand information while running campaigns, and ensure 💪stronger relationships.

Explore Features to Run Your Business Online H3 🚀

👥 Contact Management

  • Collect, segment, and manage a high amount of contacts.
  • Builder user-interaction and preferences-focused workflows.
  • Track campaign performances to set metrics.

✉️ Email Campaign Management

  • Create, organize, and manage campaigns.
  • Design templates that attract more leads.
  • Run a series of emails with email sequences.
  • Build campaigns using Drag-and-drop campaign builder.
  • Optimize email strategies through effective A/B testing.

📂 Segmentation & Personalization

  • Personalize email copies with dynamic blocks and tags.
  • Add notes to contact lists for better categorization.
  • Add custom fields to ensure more tailored data collection.

🔄 Email Automation

  • Automate email campaigns for consistent communication.
  • Run specific triggers based on user behaviors.
  • Leverage visually automation flow builder for workflows.

🧩 Integration

  • Integrates with Gravity Forms to automate form data collection.
  • Contact form 7 integration streamlines lead management.
  • FormGent, FluentForm & SureForms ensure interactive form creation and data handling.
  • Helps re-engage potential buyers for abandoned cart recovery emails.
  • Easy Digital Downloads (EDD) allows tracking of target customers’ purchase history.
  • Offers secure data passing methods through webhooks.

Vendtics email marketing tool is for whom?

Our automated email automation plugin for WordPress is built for a wide range of institutions and industries. From online businesses to offline services, Vendtics gives you complete suit for contact management. Here are a few sectors where Vendtics stands as a perfect solution:

🛍️ E-Commerce Stores
From personalized product recommendations to abandoned cart reminders, send every update with Vendtics detailed data report.

🍱 Restaurants & Cafes
With Vendtics email marketing plugin, Restaurants and Cafes can promote offers in order drive more engagements.

🎓 Educational Institutions
Vendtics’ email automation system allows you to send course updates, run newsletters, and build more effective communication with learners.

🎨 Professionals & Agencies
Creative professionals can share project portfolios and run productive campaigns.

🏨 Hotels and Hospitals
Sending welcome emails, booking confirmations, or feedback requests, everything is should not require any boundaries with Vendtics. Send unlimited business emails ensuring smoother communications.

🛠️ Home Service Providers
With Vendtics you can send reminders, service updates, and promotions for maintenance or repair services.

With Vendtics, businesses of all types can streamline and elevate their email marketing effortlessly. Every decision you make will be informed, data-driven, and strategic—empowering you to reach new heights of success.
sections.faq:
Is Vendtics self-hosted, and where is the data stored?

Yes, Vendtics is entirely self-hosted. It operates independently and does not connect to any of our SaaS servers. You retain full ownership of your data, which is hosted exclusively on your own server.

Is Vendtics email marketing plugin for WordPress GDPR-Compliant

Yes, the Vendtics email automation plugin ensures your collected data is stored within the WordPress system and never shared within other servers.

Do you offer a user guide or documentation?

Vendtics offers a suite of user resource guides to help you get started and keep moving smoothly. Reach out to our support anytime you face an issue. Read our Blogs and Documentation for an efficient set-up.

Is there any limitation on sending emails?

You can send mails to an unlimited number of email addresses. Vendtics does not restrict you from sending emails to your contacts.

Does this WordPress email marketing plugin slow down my site?

Vendtics WordPress email marketing plugin is a self-hosted and lightweight solution. It is specifically designed for WordPress to ensure minimal impact on your site, so there’s no risk of your site performance.
